title: Corn Dip – From Iowa Via Mexico
description:
From Well-Plated By Erin: “Creamy, cheesy, and southwest-spiced, this fiesta corn dip is one of those no-brainer
recipes that people go crazy over. Want to feel like the bell of the appetizer ball? Be the person who brings
creamy street corn dip! Mexican corn dip is among the small rotation of reliable, crowd-pleasing appetizer
recipes that have become signatures. Not only do my friends stay consistently excited about this recipes—it’s
gotten to the point where I’m practically not allowed to bring anything else!”
ingredients: 1 cup 2% plain Greek yogurt (do not use non-fat)
3 cans Mexican-style corn (11-ounce cans) sometimes called Fiesta
4 large green onions (or 6 small) sliced (white and green parts)
Tabasco Cholula or similar hot sauce, optional for serving
Fritos (corn) Scoops or vegetables for serving
directions: In a large bowl, stir together the yogurt, mayo, chili powder, garlic powder, and cumin.
Stir in the corn, cheese, green onions, and jalapeno.
Refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. Sprinkle with hot sauce and serve.
